Bundled example corpus

Source: R/data.R
sm_example_db.Rd

A pre-built synthetic corpus with 200 works, 80 authors, 5 clusters, and embeddings. Created with sm_example_corpus(seed = 42).

Usage

sm_example_db

Format

An sm_corpus S3 object.

Source

Synthetically generated.

Examples

data(sm_example_db)
print(sm_example_db)
#> 
#> ── <sm_corpus> ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> Works: 200 | Authors: 80 | Institutions: 0
#> Years: 2015 - 2024
#> Sources (journals): 10
#> Embeddings: 200 x 64
#> Provenance: synthetic (200)
